//: Strict type-check configuration for the standalone storefront.
`npm run typecheck` runs tsc --noEmit against this file; a Vite build is
bundling only and is NOT type-check coverage (constitution: stack-typescript
rules). The two are separate gates on purpose.
exactOptionalPropertyTypes and noUncheckedIndexedAccess are mandatory here
for the same reason as in the harness: this UI narrows untrusted HTTP
payloads, where an absent property and an explicit undefined mean different
things and every indexed lookup can miss.
Note the absence of webmcp-types. This storefront has no browser-tool
surface at all, and a type package for one would invite adding it.
